caption: The drawing consists of a rectangular section centrally positioned on a larger off-white or beige sheet. The rectangular section features a repeating pattern of leaf-like shapes. These shapes are predominantly filled with vertical streaks of green, complemented with accents of pink, pale yellow, and subtle blue, giving a multicolored effect. The leaves are bordered and intersected by a lace-like or netted pattern rendered in white, creating a sense of interweaving across the dark background, which appears to be deep green or black. The overall composition is densely packed with these leaf forms and lace lines, leaving little negative space within the rectangular pattern. The background sheet contains faint handwritten text beneath the pattern, with one name and one location discernible: “Westchester County” and “Isabella M. Strange.” There are also light brown spots and signs of aging visible on the surrounding off-white area.
title: Material used in Costume
